newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan says no deception in pork exports to Japan.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan says no deception in pork exports to Japan.

text.p: Taiwan's Council of Agriculture officials on Wednesday denied Canadian exporters' allegations that Taiwan exporters were evading Japan's stiff emergency tariffs through false invoicing.
"We have not found any case of illegal acts in pork exports to Japan," an official of the cabinet agency told Reuters when asked about the Canadian allegation.
Canada Pork International president Jim Morris alleged on Tuesday that Taiwan pork exporters were evading Japanese tariffs through false invoicing.
"Taiwan will continue to evade the Japanese duty system through false invoicing, and the Japanese government will continue to pretend that it doesn't exist," Morris said.
Morris's trade group is actively promoting Canadian pork exports to Japan.
